SELECT COUNT( * ) FROM e071k INTO lv_count

SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070c INTO ls_client WHERE trkorr = lv_request.

IF ls_header-trfunction <> 'W' OR ls_header-strkorr <> space OR
APPEND LINES OF ls_request-objects TO lt_objects.
APPEND LINES OF ls_request-keys TO lt_keys.
APPEND LINES OF ls_request-keys_str TO lt_string_keys.

headers = lt_headers clients = lt_clients objects = lt_objects

ev_object_count = lines( lt_objects ). CONDENSE ev_object_count NO-GAPS.
ev_key_count = lines( lt_keys ). CONDENSE ev_key_count NO-GAPS.

  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM IT_START_TAB COMPARING TRKORR.
  LOOP AT IT_START_TAB.
    CLEAR LV_TRSTATUS.
    SELECT SINGLE TRSTATUS FROM E070 INTO LV_TRSTATUS
                           WHERE TRKORR = IT_START_TAB-TRKORR.
    LOOP AT IT_E071_TAB INTO LT_E071_TAB

      APPEND LT_E071K_TAB.
      DELETE IT_E071K_TAB.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF LV_TRSTATUS <> 'D'.
*request was released -> collect all entries for TRKORR
      SELECT DISTINCT GUID FROM SCDT_E071_TRIGG INTO TABLE LT_GUID
                          WHERE TRKORR = IT_START_TAB-TRKORR.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.

          SELECT * FROM SCDT_E071K_TRIGG INTO TABLE LT_E071K_TRIGG
                   WHERE GUID = LT_GUID.
          LOOP AT LT_E071K_TRIGG.
            MOVE-CORRESPONDING LT_E071K_TRIGG TO LT_E071K_TAB.
            LT_E071K_TAB-TRKORR = IT_START_TAB-TRKORR.
